hook.text: A screenshot can only show one angle.

lines.text: A screenshot can only show one angle.
A jewelry render starts from a screenshot or from the 3D file.
lines.say: A jewelry render starts from a screenshot or from the three D file.

lines.text: A screenshot is a flat picture of what's on your screen.
A 3D file can be turned and seen from any angle,
lines.say: A three D file can be turned and seen from any angle,

lines.text: so one file can give the render every view of the piece.
An STL file keeps only the surface, with no materials or units.
lines.say: An S T L file keeps only the surface, with no materials or units.

lines.text: A Rhino .3dm keeps every part on its layer with its material,
lines.say: A Rhino three D M keeps every part on its layer with its material,

lines.text: and it records the units, millimeters for most jewelry.
So the 3D file gives a render much more to go on.
lines.say: So the three D file gives a render much more to go on.

lines.text: From one 3D file, this ring was rendered from every side.
lines.say: From one three D file, this ring was rendered from every side.

post.youtube_title: Jewelry rendering from a screenshot or a 3D file
post.caption: A screenshot is one flat view of a piece, while a 3D file can be turned to any angle. A Rhino .3dm also keeps every part with its material and units, so the 3D file gives a jewelry render more to work with. The renders in this video were made with HeyGema.
